### Data Cleaning/Organization

```{r}
# Read the CSV file 
raw_data <- read.csv("workout_fitness_tracker_data.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Inspect the data structure
str(data)
head(data)

numeric_cols <- c("Age", 
                  "Height.cm", 
                  "Weight.kg", 
                  "BMI", 
                  "Workout.Duration.minutes", 
                  "CaloriesBurned", 
                  "HeartRate.bpm", 
                  "Steps.Taken", 
                  "DistanceRan.km", 
                  "Sleep.Hours", 
                  "Water.Intake.liters", 
                  "Daily.Calories.Intake",
                  "Resting.Heart.Rate.bpm",
                  "VO2.Max",
                  "BodyFat.Percentage")

# Convert those columns to numeric
data[numeric_cols] <- lapply(data[numeric_cols], function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# 5. Convert categorical columns to factors
factor_cols <- c("Gender", 
                 "Workout_Type", 
                 "WorkoutIntensity", 
                 "Mood.Before.Workout", 
                 "Mood.After.Workout")

data[factor_cols] <- lapply(data[factor_cols], function(x) as.factor(x))

# 6. Check the final structure
str(data)
```



### EDA: Demographic Analysis

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Summary statistics for demographic variables
demographics_summary <- data %>% 
  select(age, gender, height, weight, BMI) %>% 
  summary()
print(demographics_summary)

# Age Distribution Histogram
ggplot(data, aes(x = age)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution", x = "Age", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# Gender Distribution Bar Plot (if the 'gender' column exists)
if("gender" %in% colnames(data)){
  ggplot(data, aes(x = gender)) +
    geom_bar(fill = "coral", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Gender Distribution", x = "Gender", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```



### EDA: Performance Metrics

```{r}
# Summary statistics for performance metrics
performance_summary <- data %>% 
  select(workout_duration, calories, heart_rate) %>% 
  summary()
print(performance_summary)

# Scatter Plot: Workout Duration vs. Calorie Burn
if(all(c("workout_duration", "calories") %in% colnames(data))){
  ggplot(data, aes(x = workout_duration, y = calories)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "darkgreen") +
    labs(title = "Workout Duration vs. Calorie Burn", 
         x = "Workout Duration (min)", y = "Calories Burned") +
    theme_minimal()
}

# Heart Rate Distribution Histogram
if("heart_rate" %in% colnames(data)){
  ggplot(data, aes(x = heart_rate)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "purple", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Heart Rate Distribution", 
         x = "Heart Rate (bpm)", y = "Frequency") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```



### EDA: Workout Patterns

```{r}
# Frequency of Workout Types (if the 'workout_type' column exists)
if("workout_type" %in% colnames(data)){
  ggplot(data, aes(x = workout_type)) +
    geom_bar(fill = "orange", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Frequency of Workout Types", 
         x = "Workout Type", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal()
  
  # Boxplot: Workout Duration by Workout Type
  ggplot(data, aes(x = workout_type, y = workout_duration)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Workout Duration by Workout Type", 
         x = "Workout Type", y = "Duration (min)") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```
